limitations: Repeated identical frames on a shared host describe observed timing variation, not statistical confidence, recovery or portable performance.
No separate warmup. Every subprocess is fresh; OS file caches and concurrent user work may vary. Parent verification and comparison are excluded from wall.
Only FP32. Torch GPU counters exclude host memory and other device users. Loading holds one checkpoint byte buffer alongside deserialized weights.
Raw inverse-depth/disparity is retained. FeatDepth training overlap with KITTI raw is possible; no holdout-based model refinement.
Depth differences alone do not prove calibration equality; evaluate six-DoF search and held-out observations separately.
Parsed values and embedded JSON notes normalize external/workspace paths; original content digests are retained.
